:::{#exm-not-hermitian}
#### A symmetric complex matrix that is not Hermitian

$$
\underbrace{\matr{B}}_{2 \times 2} =
\begin{bmatrix}
0 & i \\
i & 0
\end{bmatrix}
$$

is symmetric, $\tp{\matr{B}} = \matr{B}$,
but it is not Hermitian:

$$
\underbrace{\matr{B}^{\mathsf{H}}}_{2 \times 2} =
\begin{bmatrix}
0 & -i \\
-i & 0
\end{bmatrix}
\neq \matr{B}.
$$

:::
